channel.title: Bloomberg — diagnostic source feed
channel.description: Diagnostic feed grouped by acquisition connector.

item.title: Telecom Giant Globe Bets on AI for Next Billion-Dollar Business
item.description: Globe Telecom Inc. is betting the artificial intelligence boom can turn its data-center venture into its next billion-dollar business as fintech arm Mynt Inc. heads for a record Philippine initial public offering.
item.dc:creator: Neil Jerome Morales

item.title: OpenAI to Help Australia on AI Defense After Government Hack
item.description: OpenAI on Tuesday apologized for its AI models breaching Australian government websites and promised to set up a new task force as part of reforms after the incident.
item.dc:creator: James Mayger and Vlad Savov

item.title: Data Centers, AI Face Skepticism in Australia
item.description: Legal expert Jeannie Paterson says that data security fears over AI could could trigger a governance debate in Australia ahead of a potential Anthropic IPO, sparking renewed awareness over national and cross-border enforcement of anti-hacking regulations. (Source: Bloomberg)

item.title: AI Faces $6 Trillion Test to Justify Data Centers, Bain Says
item.description: The global AI industry needs to earn $6 trillion in annual revenue by 2031 to justify the capital being deployed to build data centers around the world, Bain & Co. said.
item.dc:creator: Saritha Rai

item.title: Nothing Debuts $399 Metal-and-Glass Pro Headphones to Take on Apple, Bose, Sony
item.description: Nothing Technologies Ltd., the consumer electronics startup known for its distinctive designs, introduced a high-end pair of wireless headphones priced at $399, its latest effort to peel market share away from Sony Group Corp., Apple Inc., Bose Corp. and other companies competing in the premium segment.
item.dc:creator: Chris Welch

item.title: Nvidia, Anthropic CEOs to Attend Trump-Johnson Lunch on AI Risks
item.description: Nvidia Corp. Chief Executive Officer Jensen Huang, Anthropic PBC head Dario Amodei and Palantir Technologies Inc. CEO Alex Karp are slated to attend a lunch with US President Donald Trump to discuss artificial intelligence risks.
item.dc:creator: Maggie Eastland and Shirin Ghaffary

item.title: Axed Sydney Data Center Shows Backlash to Australia’s AI Boom
item.description: Australia’s data-center boom is running into growing community resistance, with Goodman Group scrapping plans for a 24-hour facility in suburban Sydney after a backlash from local residents.
item.dc:creator: Keira Wright and Joe Flynn

item.title: OpenAI Scraps Debut of Latest Astra Model Over Safety Risks
item.description: OpenAI is holding back a version of its Astra artificial intelligence model after the software failed to perform as well on safety evaluations as the current iteration.
item.dc:creator: Rachel Metz

item.title: Stocks & Bonds Sell Off as Oil Drives Yields Higher
item.description: The Close brings you the latest news and analysis leading up to the final minutes and seconds before and after the closing bell on Wall Street. Today's guests are Vanguard Fixed Income Client Portfolio Manager Rebecca Venter, First Founder & CEO Libby Leffler, Morningstar Senior Equity Analyst David Swartz, Rockefeller International Chairman Ruchir Sharma, Russell Investments President & CIO Kate El-Hillow, AMD CEO Lisa Su & World Labs CEO Fei-Fei Li, JPMorgan Asset Management Executive Director, Global Market Strategist Jack Manley, Adobe Digital Insights Director Vivek Pandya, & SPG Global Managing Director Simon Gallagher. (Source: Bloomberg)

item.title: El-Hillow: We Should Get Comfortable With Higher Rates
item.description: Kate El-Hillow of Russell Investments said the recent jump in Treasury yields should not be viewed as purely temporary. In response to a question about whether the rise in yields might fade if geopolitical tensions ease, she argued investors should get comfortable with a "higher floor" and "rates for longer." She speaks with Romaine Bostick & Emily Graffeo on "The Close." (Source: Bloomberg)

item.title: Premium Sports Content Is Here To Stay: Fmr Hulu and Netflix Executive Simon Gallagher
item.description: Simon Gallagher of SPG Global discussed NBC regaining MLB rights and the league’s growing mix of broadcast and streaming distribution, including Peacock. He said the biggest issue is fragmentation: with roughly 2,500 baseball games, it is hard for viewers to figure out where a specific game is available, since rights are spread across multiple platforms. He speaks with Romaine Bostick on "The Close." (Source: Bloomberg)

item.title: Rockefeller’s Ruchir Sharma Warns AI Bubble To Burst After 10-Year Yield Hits 5%
item.description: Ruchir Sharma, Chairman at Rockefeller International and Founder and CIO of Breakout Capital, warns that rising Treasury yields could become a danger zone for the AI trade. Sharma’s recent column arguing that a 5% level on the 10-year yield could potentially derail the AI boom, notes that yields are now meaningfully above that threshold and asking what 5.2% implies for the sector. He speaks with Romaine Bostick & Emily Graffeo on "The Close." (Source: Bloomberg)

item.title: Libby Leffler on Nvidia Buyback, State of AI Trade
item.description: Libby Leffler says Nvidia’s new system designed to keep AI agents from “going awry” is a positive step in the right direction. She argued that buybacks “don’t lie” and said the day’s weakness in markets looked more like a macro-driven move tied to oil, Treasury yields and broader AI-news sentiment than a problem with Nvidia’s underlying model. She speaks to Romaine Bostick & Emily Graffeo on "The Close." (Source: Bloomberg)

item.title: AMD to Buy Fei-Fei Li’s World Labs AI Startup for $8.2 Billion
item.description: Chipmaker AMD agreed to acquire World Labs for $8.2 billion, gaining an AI startup founded by industry pioneer and researcher Fei-Fei Li. Ed Ludlow explains why this is such a big deal for both companies (Source: Bloomberg)

item.title: AMD Acquires Fei-Fei Li’s World Labs for $8.2 Billion
item.description: AMD is acquiring World Labs, an AI startup founded by industry pioneer and researcher Fei-Fei Li, in an all-stock transaction valuing World Labs at about $8.2 billion. AMD CEO Lisa Su and World Labs co-founder and CEO Fei-Fei Li sit down with Bloomberg Tech's Ed Ludlow to discuss why AMD is purchasing World Labs, the two companies' shared vision for AI's future encompassing all layers of the stack, and how the industry needs to come together for shared responsibility in developing a safe technology that benefits all of society. (Source: Bloomberg)

item.title: AMD to Buy Fei-Fei Li’s World Labs AI Startup for $8.2 Billion
item.description: Chipmaker Advanced Micro Devices Inc. agreed to acquire World Labs for $8.2 billion, gaining an artificial intelligence startup founded by industry pioneer and researcher Fei-Fei Li.
item.dc:creator: Ed Ludlow

item.title: Will New China AI ETF Have Its 'Shiny Moment'?
item.description: Kevin Carter, founder & CIO of EMQQ Global, joins Scarlet Fu and Eric Balchunas on "Bloomberg ETF IQ." They discuss the China AI Tigers ETF (ticker: TGRZ). (Source: Bloomberg)

item.title: Manus Expands AI Tools in Renewed Push Into Agent Market
item.description: Manus, an artificial intelligence startup founded in China, is expanding its AI agent offerings, aiming to gain further ground in one of the tech industry’s hottest areas.
item.dc:creator: Micah Barkley

item.title: Oil Surges, Nvidia Unleashes a Record $150B Buyback
item.description: Get a jump start on the US trading day with Dani Burger on "Bloomberg Open Interest." Oil surges as President Trump rejects Iran’s Hormuz proposa. Meanwhile, Nvidia makes a record $150 billion bet on its own stock. Plus, Akamai CEO Tom Leighton on a $12 billion Anthropic deal, LPL Financial CEO Rich Steinmeier on why AI won’t replace your advisor, and SpaceX sends Starship back to the skies. (Source: Bloomberg)

item.title: Nvidia Debuts System Meant to Stop AI Agents From Going Awry
item.description: Nvidia Corp. introduced a new double-layered artificial intelligence security system that it says would have prevented the recent high-profile breach of Hugging Face by OpenAI’s AI models.
item.dc:creator: Maggie Eastland
